publicFootprint.scope: Exact known-role equality in named public transaction/effect fields; no witness or decrypted-note inspection
publicFootprint.matching: Whole field numeric equality; no substring scan; commitments and delivery matches do not decode identities
publicFootprint.limits: Does not test derived identifiers, linkability across transactions, funding timing, RPC metadata, proof bytes, protocol constants or contract-class contents. Private delivery tags/payload are public serialized fields, not decrypted private data. Absence of exact matches is not proof of anonymity.

noteMembership.scope: in-process findLeavesIndexes and scoped private-nullifier oracle calls plus diagnostic membership reads; not network capture or anonymity evidence
noteMembership.interpretation: Unknown nullifiers are not proof of missing initialization or pending-read misclassification; initializerless accounts need no initialization marker; cache hits may bypass observation; matches are hypotheses, not causes
